page.overview:
What is Aoskar?

Aoskar, also known as the Power of Portals, the Keeper of Gateways, and the God of Doors was the self-appointed god of portals.

His holy symbol resembled, and often took the form of, a large key.

After being slain and cast out by the Lady of Pain, Aoskar remained adrift in the Astral Plane.

Aoskar was venerated as a god within his own temple in the City of Doors. At the peak of his influence, Aoskar boasted half the planewalkers in Sigil among his worshipers. Some even maintained the belief that the Lady of Pain herself, was merely an aspect of Aoskar.
